description: Get specific nodes from a Figma design file by their node ids. Returns a compact map of node id to { name, type }. Use to inspect particular frames, components, or layers within a design file.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (the segment after /file/ or /design/ in a Figma URL).

node_ids.description: Comma-separated list of node ids to retrieve (e.g. "1:2,1:3").

name: get_file_nodes
